entities.summary:
Rashmoni Das, popularly known as Lokamata Rani Rashmoni, also spelled as Rani Rasmani,, was an Indian businesswoman, entrepreneur, Zamindar, philanthropist and the founder of the Dakshineswar Kali Temple in Kolkata. She remained closely associated with Sri Ramakrishna Paramhansa after she appointed him as the priest of the Dakshineswar temple. She was also one of the earliest social reformers in early nineteenth-century Bengal and was one of the forerunners of the Bengal Renaissance.

Besides, she also led many of the resistances against the encroaching British administration and their presence in all walks of colonial society in the Bengal province. Rani Rashmoni was a activists & reformers (1793-09-28–1861-02-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
